paragraphs: The Intermediate Website Kit builds off the beginner kits, mainly by including a pre-configured Eleventy environment. This setup allows for reusable components, centralized data, and greater scalability as your clients grow. Additionally, a blog has been provided through Decap CMS, enabling your clients to manage their own content. This can easily be adapted to various use cases, such as menus, job listing boards, portfolios, and more. A few additional plugins have also been included to enhance the developer experience, offering HTML/CSS minification, JS bundling/minification, and automatic…

An example website is also provided, with easy substitution of website sections through the use of CodeStitch's vanilla component library. This kit aims to get any project off the ground as quickly as possible, with deployment achievable in as little as two minutes, including CMS hosting.
